title: Line of business codes
text:
Line of business codes

 LOBs supported by 
UNICEDE
/2.

The Line Of Business codes vary 
by country and by version
 of 
UNICEDE
/2. Navigate to the appropriate country listing to view available LOB codes for that country.

Note:

For some countries, the valid lines of business are different for Market Share data than they are for other kinds of data (sums insured, etc).
